intent: Oversized editorial landing hero for a design studio or founder-led product, with one rotating word as the only animation.

stack.fonts: font-display (Bricolage Grotesque), font-serif (Instrument Serif), font-mono (Geist Mono)

rows: status row: live dot + status left, location right
headline block with spinning badge top-right
1px rule, then 12-col grid: body (6/5 cols) + actions (6/7 cols, right-aligned)

motion.cta: arrow chip rotates -45deg on hover; button lifts 2px
motion.reducedMotion: disable rotation, spin and ping entirely

responsive.mobile: status row wraps; headline ~46px; badge hidden; body and actions stack; client names wrap
responsive.md: badge visible at 144px; grid splits body/actions

accessibility: sr-only full headline including every word; animated copy aria-hidden

content.body: One or two sentences, specific and human. Mention who it's for and what you do.

avoid: generic SaaS copy like 'Supercharge your workflow'
more than one animated element in the headline
